messages:
Rafi (CS): Hey team — kicking off Solstice pilot. Maya (PM) wants a 3-week pilot to validate: 1) KB embeddings powering quick search in agent UI, 2) AI-suggested reply snippets for billing tickets, 3) clear metrics tied to renewal (60d out). Can we assign owners and draft a timeline?

Maya (Solstice): Thanks Rafi. Top goals: 30% reduction AHT on billing, precision@3 for embeds >0.75, and p95 latency <180ms. We'll hand over a sanitized KB + 48h logs. Pilot target start in 12 days.

Jules (Solutions): I'll take integration + prompt tuning. Proposed milestones:
- Day0: access + schema mapping
- Day5: prototype endpoint + UI hook
- Day10: retrieval tuning + evals
- Day18: canary + metrics collection
Need to confirm auth (API key or SSO) and whether they want hosted or private routing.

Asha (Eng): I'll own runtime & canary. For prototype use-hosted; if compliance shows up we'll enable private fallback. Action for Maya: send avg concurrent agents and expected qps. I'll size batching/kv cache once we have that.

Diego (Enablement): I can run a 60m hands-on workshop and produce a 1-pager playbook + troubleshooting checklist. Request two power users to shadow the canary.

Maya (Solstice): Concurrent agents avg 8, peak 20. No PII in sample exports. We'll share KB and logs by EOD tomorrow. Procurement check at ~Day60 — we'll need adoption signals early.

Rafi (CS): Risks: renewal timeline + embedding index cost if full KB ingested. We'll emphasize renewal-linked metrics (AHT, precision, deflection). I'll prepare a one-pager tying pilot metrics to renewal considerations.

scheduler-bot: Meeting created: "Solstice Pilot Kickoff" in 48h with Maya, Rafi, Jules, Asha, Diego.

Jules (Solutions): Cost estimate quick: prototype sampling ~45k tokens/week; full pilot up to ~170k tokens/week depending on retrieval frequency. I'll propose a sampling plan to limit spend.

Asha (Eng): Action items for Maya: KB export format, avg doc length, refresh cadence for embeddings (daily vs weekly), and whether attachments need indexing.

Maya (Solstice): We'll send KB export (markdown + csv), avg doc length ~600 words, daily refresh OK for pilot, attachments not required for now.

Diego (Enablement): For the workshop I need two ticket templates + a list of common billing questions to tailor examples. Also prefer a 2-step shadowing schedule during canary.

Rafi (CS): Quick pinned summary:
```
Owners & Deadlines:
- Jules: integration + prototype (due Day5)
- Asha: runtime sizing + canary plan (due Day9)
- Diego: enablement materials + workshop (due Day14)
- Maya: KB export + logs (due Day1/EOD)
- Rafi: pilot one-pager & renewal-aligned dashboard (due Day3)
Risks: procurement review at ~Day60; embedding storage/cost if full KB used; Private deployment adds ~2w.
Success Criteria (Solstice): 30% AHT reduction for billing, precision@3 >0.75, p95 <=180ms
```
I'll create the shared tracker and post the one-pager after kickoff. Ping me to swap owners or if we need to fast-track private checklist. :white_check_mark:
